_doc: Stage-2 parts for tools/blender/gf_hero/s2_selene_parts.py. Metres, Blender axes (Z up, faces -Y, +X = her LEFT). Every piece is given for her left side and built mirrored unless it is on the centre line. Sources: the approved front (references/SELENE_front_approved.png, 2.285 mm/px, centre x 761 px, sabaton tips y 987 px) for outlines and heights, the recentred stage-1 blockout s303 for depths and attachment points, brief.md for construction. Cloth pieces are regular grids (u across, v down) so stage 3 can hang x_ chains on their rows; gf_mask R = v (0 at the attachment, 1 at the hem), G = u.

body._doc: the body under-layer: leg girth (the landmark-warped MakeHuman legs are a model's; the concept's leggings and greaves need fuller thighs and calves): per 1 cm slab and side, the cross-section is scaled about its centre to the target mean radius (z, r), blended in over the ankle and out over the hip

zones._doc: face material index of the body: eyeballs = eye; z > head_z (|x| < 0.13) = skin; the arms (|x| > arm_x, z > 1.5) = skin, the glove from glove_x to the knuckles (glove_end_x) = glove; the torso = suit, the legs below leg_z = legging. The painter blends skin / suit and suit / legging by smooth analytic lines (neckline, armholes, hip line), so these face zones only pick the painter.

hair._doc: the swept-up silver hair: a shell over the scalp (the body's own head faces pushed out: thickness from the rim to the crown), hairline as z by azimuth around the head centre (0 = the face, 180 = the nape), the ears left out; the high bun on the crown (a twisted lofted knot, the concept's bun; the stage-1 blockout put it 0.2 m behind the head: defect 1), a glowing band at its base, locks: two long strands framing the face each side and swept clumps rising from the nape and the sides to the bun

locks._doc: long face-framing strand in front of the ear, to the collar (the concept's two strands)
a thin wisp off the temple
swept clumps rising to the bun (sides and back)
swept strands from the temples and the sides up to the bun (break the shell into locks)

crown._doc: SIX storm-crystal shards floating round the head, three per side as the approved concept draws them (the stage brief said five; the concept wins, brief section 7.2 Q1, pending the user). Each is a separate rigid piece (a gold-rimmed crystal: an elongated hexagon, chamfered, the faces set in) on its own bone x_crown_01..06 under head_top. Positions from the concept relative to the eyes (upper 0.178 m, middle 0.105, lower 0.025 above them), |x| scaled 0.9 to the model's narrower head; [x, y, z, length, width, lean_deg (+ = top leans in toward the head)]

collar._doc: the high collar (black, gold rims) round the neck from the shoulder line to under the jaw, lower at the front with a small V; the collar gem (a faceted diamond in a gold setting) at its base; the harness straps and the gold neckline trim over the bust; the gold waist straps

belt._doc: the belt at the hips (black leather, gold rims), dipping to a V at the front; two big gold rings at the front (the hip panels hang from them); a gold-rimmed dark plate on each hip

shoulders._doc: the shoulder ornament on each upper arm: an armlet band (dark plate, gold rims) whose lower half hides the tops of the cape and the mantle, a gold ring on its front, two pointed gold-rimmed blades (the concept's bow points: up-and-out and down-and-back)

cloth._doc: cloth sheets (thick 0.008 m, closed): profiles by v (0 = attachment, 1 = hem): z, inner / outer edge x, depth y; hem_z(u) is added over the last rows (tatters); folds are sine waves across u growing with v. chain = the suggested stage-3 helper chain (one link per v range)

tabard._doc: the pale front tabard between the legs (narrow: the black leggings and the knee plates show between it and the hip panels, as drawn)

gauntlets._doc: dark fingerless gauntlets: a bracer from the pointed top edge (mid-forearm, the point on the top) to past the wrist, gold rims; a plate over the back of the hand to the knuckles; ice-blue claw caps on all ten fingertips (rigid, skinned to the last phalanx)

legs._doc: greaves (dark navy plate, gold rims) over the front 250 degrees of the shin with a point up at the front; a pointed knee cop; a leaf blade on the outside of each knee (the concept's knee fins); the glowing V slots are painted

sabatons._doc: pointed heeled sabatons round the heeled foot: a shaft round the ankle (flared top under the greave), a foot shell lofted from the heel to a long pointed toe (sections across the foot, never thinner than the foot inside + gap), a heel block to the ground; gold rims and painted lames
sabatons._doc_stations: [y, z_sole, z_top, half_width] from the heel to the toe tip
